'''Microaxial''' was a company that manufactured [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigational computers]] for [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Their products included the [[LpL computer]] unit and [[HyD modular navicomputer/Legends|HyD modular navicomputer]].<ref name="SWS" />
